rows.label: qev018801_MSG0001
rows.name:
Thanks for your continued patronage of
the Shining Erudition Hall! I've been
waiting for you![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0002
rows.name:
In recognition of your efforts, you've
finally earned the right to become a
gold member![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0003
rows.name:
As a shiny gold member, you'll get an
even better rate for your Miranium![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0004
rows.name:
And as a special service, I'll present you
with a much bigger reward than usual![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0005
rows.name:
Your task is to gather Aurora Stone and Arc
Sand Ore![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0006
rows.name:
How about it? Want to give it a try?
It's not a bad deal, right?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0007
rows.name:
Good! Mee-mee will soon be number one on
NLA's rich list![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0008
rows.name:
I'll give the alchemy machine a hyper
upgrade and build up my savings![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_JNK0010
rows.name: Question

rows.label: qev018801_SEL0011
rows.name: Ask what she intends to do with that much money.

rows.label: qev018801_JNK0020
rows.name: Support

rows.label: qev018801_SEL0021
rows.name: Cheer Mee-mee on.

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0009
rows.name:
Why I want money...? When I told a
Nopon, they laughed and called me
strange...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0010
rows.name:
Well... I'll tell you all about it once
you're a gold member, so do your best![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0011
rows.name:
Thanks! Just bring me the materials, and
I'll build an amazing machine![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0012
rows.name:
Once I do, please exchange
lots and lots of Miranium![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0013
rows.name:
Let's join hands and dash, dash down the
road to riches![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0014
rows.name:
I'm well on my way to being number one
on NLA's rich list![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0015
rows.name:
I've got to get loads of Miranium and
make money![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0016
rows.name:
While you gather Aurora Stone and Arc Sand
Ore, be sure to cash in lots of Miranium
too![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0017
rows.name: Hey, hey! Did you get what I asked for?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0018
rows.name:
Hurry, or I'll never catch up to number
one on the rich list![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0019
rows.name:
Wow! Now I can upgrade the alchemy
machine and save even more money![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0020
rows.name:
Yes! You're a gold member as of today!
Please accept this gift![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0021
rows.name:
Hehe! With your help, Mee-mee has
finally reached number two on the rich
list![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0022
rows.name:
So much money, I'm so happy! Look, look
at all Mee-mee's savings![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_JNK0030
rows.name: Question

rows.label: qev018801_SEL0031
rows.name: Ask what on earth she uses that money for.

rows.label: qev018801_JNK0040
rows.name: Interest

rows.label: qev018801_SEL0041
rows.name: Ask for the exact amount of her savings.

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0023
rows.name:
Huh? Spend it? If I spend it, I'll have
less money, right?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0024
rows.name:
Then I'll be further from number one! I
save and hardly spend anything![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0025
rows.name:
About 209.5 billion, I think? It was
hard saving that much![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0026
rows.name:
I've been saving every day, barely even
eating to build up my savings![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0027
rows.name: ...Eh? What is money for, you say?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0028
rows.name:
It's a score that shows how wonderful
Mee-mee's super alchemy machine is![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0029
rows.name:
Earn lots of points, go up in rank, and
I'm happy. I get even happier if I'm
number one![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_JNK0050
rows.name: Negative

rows.label: qev018801_SEL0051
rows.name: Cannot empathize with Mee-mee's way of thinking.

rows.label: qev018801_JNK0060
rows.name: Affirmative

rows.label: qev018801_SEL0061
rows.name: Empathize with Mee-mee's way of thinking.

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0030
rows.name: Hmm... You sound like the Nopon, too.[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0031
rows.name:
They tell me it's a waste to have all
this money and just keep saving it![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0032
rows.name:
But there's hardly anything I want...
Mee-mee will be happy as long as she's
number one![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0033
rows.name:
You're not just a gold member... You're
a true companion![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018801_MSG0034
rows.name:
All right! Let's make loads of money
together and save our way to number one![ST:wait ]
